fullPassage: Children are the greatest agents of cultural change. They are still actively learning, whereas adults tend to be less receptive to new ideas. Peter and Iona Opie, who devoted a lifetime to studying the culture of schoolchildren, showed that rhymes, sayings, and career objectives tend to be transmitted more from child to child than from parent to child. The pool of children can be thought of as the engine room of cultural evolution. Once adults leave the pool, they adhere to the values they learned in childhood. Groups with a high proportion of children are therefore likely to undergo more rapid cultural change. A young population is particularly skillful at solving its problems and seizing the initiative in an ever-changing world.

어른들이 문화 변화를 지시하고 설계한다는 것
속담과 운율이 더 이상 사회적 역할을 하지 않는다는 것

questions.passage: Children are the greatest agents of cultural change. They are still actively learning, <u>whereas adults tend to be less receptive</u> to new ideas. Peter and Iona Opie, who devoted a lifetime to studying the culture of schoolchildren, showed that rhymes, sayings, and career objectives tend to be transmitted more from child to child than from parent to child. The pool of children can be thought of as the engine room of cultural evolution. Once adults leave the pool, they adhere to the values they learned in childhood. Groups with a high proportion of children are therefore likely to undergo more rapid cultural change. A young population is particularly skillful at solving its problems and seizing the initiative in an ever-changing world.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 <u>they</u>가 가리키는 것으로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 밑줄 친 부분의 주어 adults(어른들)를 명확히 가리킴. 앞 절의 주어 they는 아이들을 가리키지만, whereas 뒤의 adults가 이 절의 주체.
det.analysis:
❌ ① 아이들 — 앞 절의 they = Children
✅ ② 어른들 — whereas adults tend to be ~ 문장의 주어
❌ ③ Opie 부부 — S3 등장 별도 인물
❌ ④ 학교 교사 — 본문 등장 없음
det.tip: They are still actively learning, whereas adults tend ~ : they = 아이들, adults = 어른들. 대조 구조.

det.korean: 'Once adults leave the pool, they adhere to the values they learned in childhood'의 they는 앞 절의 adults(어른들)를 가리킴. 어른들이 어린 시절 가치를 고수한다는 맥락.
det.analysis:

det.tip: Once S V, S V : 접속절 + 주절 동일 주어. adults → they.

det.korean: 부모에게서 아이보다 아이에게서 아이로 더 많이 전달되는.

단어 확인: transmitted(1) more(2) from(3) child(4) to(5) child(6) than(7) from(8) parent(9) to(10) child(11) ✅
det.tip: more A than B: B보다 A. 전치사구 병렬 비교 표현.

questions.stem:
다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말을 조건에 맞게 영어로 쓰시오.

아이들은 __________ 이다.

[조건] (1) actively, learning, still을 모두 사용할 것
       (2) 정확히 3단어로 쓸 것

det.korean: 여전히 능동적으로 배우고 있는.
det.analysis:
원문 S2: They are still actively learning → 빈칸 = still actively learning (3단어)
단어 확인: still(1) actively(2) learning(3) ✅
조건 단어 확인: actively, learning, still → wa의 모든 토큰 포함 ✅
det.tip: still + 부사 + V-ing: 여전히 ~하고 있는. 아이들의 능동성 강조.
